type Person = { age: number; name: string };
const people: Person[] = [{ age: 20, name: "Ann" }];

const names = people.map((p) => p.nmae);
names.forEach((x) => console.log(x.toFixed()));
const ages = people.map((p) => p.agee);
ages.sort((a, b) => a - b);
console.log(ages[0] + 1);

console.log(doubled.filter((x) => x > 2));

  return f();
}
